levels.name: Find and relax
levels.focus: Learn the right muscle and practise letting it go completely.

levels.name: Steady squeezes
levels.focus: Same squeeze every time, breathing normally throughout.

levels.name: Longer holds
levels.focus: Hold a little longer while the belly and buttocks stay soft.

levels.name: Build endurance
levels.focus: Five-second holds with full release between them.

levels.name: Sitting up
levels.focus: The same work sitting upright, so the muscle works against gravity.

levels.name: Strong and smooth
levels.focus: More repetitions at six seconds, still with complete letting go.

levels.name: Standing
levels.focus: Standing tall, the hardest position for the pelvic floor.

levels.name: Long holds
levels.focus: Ten-second holds. Quality beats quantity: stop a set if form slips.

levels.name: Control
levels.focus: Four sets with long holds and fast flicks for fine control.

levels.name: Maintenance and daily life
levels.focus: Keep strength with this session and short squeezes during daily tasks like lifting or standing up.
